deep.reconstruction:
There is no mathematical derivation on this page, so nothing can be reconstructed in modern notation.

Upright at the top are a heading and a date: "…werthen Freunde." (opening or closing of a letter, 'to my esteemed friend') and "Göttingen, den 28 März 1855." There are also pen-trial scribbles at the top centre and top right. The rest of the sheet is a draft in faint pencil Kurrent, written upside down relative to the heading. It is heavily corrected, with many struck-through lines, interlinear insertions and a marginal insertion with a guide line pointing into the text. It reads as running prose. No formulas, equations or figures can be identified at this resolution.

Context: the previous folio drafts Riemann's discussion of the current distribution relevant to Nobili's colour rings. It covers the experiments of Beetz, the law of du Bois-Reymond, and image-series solutions for the potential. This matches his paper 'Zur Theorie der Nobili'schen Farbenringe', published in Poggendorff's Annalen in 1855. The date, March 1855, fits that period. This page is therefore plausibly a draft letter (or part of one) connected with that work or its submission. That attribution is my inference from context and is not read from the text. No addressee can be identified.

results.what: Dated draft of a letter, Göttingen 28 March 1855, prose only, no recoverable mathematics.

deep.surprise_reason: The page carries only a date line and an illegible, heavily corrected prose draft of a letter. No mathematical content is recoverable. Its likely link to the 1855 Nobili-rings paper is consistent with what is already known of Riemann's activity in 1855.
transcription_corrections: The upside-down main body is a continuous prose letter draft. It is not mathematics: no formulas are visible anywhere on the page.
The marks at the top centre and top right ('mmmm…', 'mm') are pen or pencil trial strokes, not text.

The marginal fragment at left-centre of the inverted text, joined to the body by a curved guide line, is an insertion into the draft. It is illegible at this resolution and should not be read as a formula.
The heading 'werthen Freunde' should be kept as tentative. It may be the end of a salutation or valediction (e.g. '...werthen Freunde'), and the preceding word is unreadable.
